reports.title: DIAMONDROCK HOSPITALITY COMPANY REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS

guidance.heading: GUIDANCE
section: The Company is raising its 2026 guidance to reflect the stronger-than-expected third quarter results and improved fourth quarter booking pace. The outlook includes the anticipated contribution from The Bellmoor Inn & Spa but assumes no additional acquisitions, dispositions, or share repurchases. It reflects current operating trends and macroeconomic conditions. Achievement of the anticipated results is subject to the risks disclosed in the Company’s filings with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, which may cause actual results to differ materially from the anticipated results expressed or implied below.
The Company now anticipates full year 2026 results to be in the following ranges:

Metric | Prior Guidance | Updated Guidance | Change at Midpoint
Comparable RevPAR Growth | 2.5% to 4.0% | 4.75% to 5.25% | 175 bps
Comparable Total RevPAR Growth | 2.75% to 4.25% | 4.75% to 5.25% | 150 bps
Adjusted EBITDA (in millions) | $310.0 to $320.0 | $322.0 to $327.0 | $9.5
Adjusted FFO (in millions) | $245.5 to $255.5 | $256.5 to $261.5 | $8.5
Adjusted FFO per diluted share | $1.18 to $1.23 | $1.24 to $1.26 | $0.04
Full year 2026 guidance is based in part on the following assumptions:
•The Bellmoor Inn & Spa is expected to contribute approximately $0.2 million to Adjusted EBITDA and Adjusted FFO in the fourth quarter of 2026;
•Full year cash corporate expenses of approximately $28.0 million, which excludes share-based compensation;
•Full year cash interest expense of approximately $58.5 million to $59.5 million; and
•Fully diluted weighted average common shares and units of 207.5 million.
